messages:
maria: deploybot just failed a staging promotion. image `websvc:ci-2026-03-21-01` cosigned OK but ECR rejected push with immutable-tag-policy. Anyone around?

deploy-bot: automated: publish attempted -> aws-ecr error 409: tag-immutability-violation. pushing digest `sha256:7a8b...c9` to repo `redwood/websvc` blocked.

kevin: ugh. was this the canary we flipped this morning?

maria: yes, canary in staging only. deploybot tried to promote a CI tag -> staging and set ephemeral tag. our immutability rule forbids overwriting existing tag name in that repo. seems CI reused `ci-2026-03-21-01`.

sara: quick question — did the CI produce a new digest or reuse the artifact?

maria: new digest. I pulled the manifest: ```
$ aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/websvc --image-ids=imageTag=ci-2026-03-21-01
IMAGE: sha256:7a8b6f...c9
```

ops-bot: note: registry policy requires canonical digest pin for any promotion outside CI namespace. Manual retag to digest or create unique tag required.

kevin: options: 1) force republish under new unique tag (ci-2026-03-21-01-<runid>), 2) pin deployment to digest and update canary config, or 3) rollback to previous digest. Production should remain blocked until decision.

maria: prefer pin-to-digest for staging canary so we don't unblock with a potentially different tag. Less churn. Then fix CI to never reuse tags for promoted images.

release-manager: what about release notes and the change window? We have a production window in 2h. If we pin now and run a small canary smoke, we can still make the window if QA signs off. If we republish, that might delay.

sara: I'll handle the republish as fallback. Plan: try digest-pin -> redeploy staging canary to `sha256:7a8b6f...c9`. If health ok for 30m, proceed with production promotion using the same digest. If anything flaky, fallback to previous digest.

kevin: assign tasks: sara do the pin+redeploy, maria update CI pipeline docs and open a follow-up PR to ensure unique promotion tags, ops-bot please block automated prod promotions until I flip the `prod_release_ok` flag.

maria: taking docs PR. quick note for release notes: mention minor runtime fix, pinned-by-digest due to registry policy — will add to draft.

sara: done: redeployed staging canary pinned to digest. health checks passed (3/3) after 2 min. leaving canary running.

ops-bot: prod promotions suspended by policy flag: `prod_release_ok=false`.

release-manager: ok let's keep the slot. if canary stays green at +30m we proceed. kevin, will you coordinate the prod flip?

kevin: yep. I'll prep the rollout steps: (1) update prod deployment manifests to imageDigest `sha256:7a8b6f...c9`, (2) dry-run apply to canary-prod, (3) if pass -> full rollout with canary 5%->50%->100% with 5m waits.

maria: filing the follow-up ticket: "CI promotion must generate unique tag or publish by digest" and adding link to PR.

sara: ping when you're ready for me to run final smoke in prod canary. :thumbsup:

kevin: will do. keeping this thread for status. thanks all.
